title: Lab Safety Reminder
transcript: Before we start today, a quick safety note. Several people came to lab last week without goggles, and we had to send them home. Starting today, if you forget yours, you can borrow a pair from the cabinet by the door, but you'll have to sign them out and return them at the end of class. Also, please tie back long hair. It's one of the most common causes of accidents.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
options: To introduce a new lab experiment
To explain a new rule about safety equipment
To report an accident that happened in lab
To ask students to buy new goggles
questions.explanation: The speaker explains that students can now borrow goggles but must sign them out.

questions.stem: What must students do if they borrow goggles?
options: Sign them out and return them after class
Bring them back the next day
questions.explanation: Borrowed goggles must be signed out and returned at the end of class.
